verdict.recommended_label_for_current_cycles: pinned optimistic K-first recurrence estimate under ideal finite-storage, conflict-free and fixed-clock assumptions

read_only_audit.limitation: The hammer independently rehashed all M248 payloads, audited producer control/data flow and recomputed every published aggregate, ratio, byte count, fit threshold, M251 replay equality and cycle-row quotient. It did not create a second retained 51.84M-row histogram artifact; M338 and M251 already have separate independent recomputes in M340 and M253.

phase_and_sample_loop_audit.finding: No sample, operator or phase loop error found. M339 keys histograms by sample_id, frozen operator index and partition, then appends phases in sample-major/operator-major/partition-major order. The M248 manifest independently contains exactly one record for every 10x4 sample/operator pair.
phase_and_sample_loop_audit.residual_p2: The analyzer relies on the frozen M248 PASS status instead of explicitly asserting the complete 10x4 key truth table before replay. The present input is complete, so this is auditability hardening rather than a numerical defect.

traffic_context.finding: M339 correctly reports PWP bytes and includes 12,288 weight bytes in every modeled DMA. It does not price pattern-code load traffic or globally resident pattern-table SRAM.

m251_q16_reproduction.finding: M339 replay_legacy_m251 exactly reproduces both frozen M251 q16 rows. M251r2 independently preserves these cycles after signed-INT8 range correction.

all_raw_match_dma_and_commit_audit.finding: The earlier free max(matcher,DMA) error is repaired: the data-dependent selective PWP DMA cannot begin before the full matcher term. Common commit is integral and added to both branches for every sample.
all_raw_match_dma_and_commit_audit.remaining_optimism: After full-phase matching, compute still needs raw/correction and chosen-pattern descriptors. Their storage, write/read ports, finite queues, rereads and spill/chunk cycles are absent. Therefore charging the scan once is not yet an executable K-first schedule.

definitions.executable_lower_bound_context_bytes: fixed context + 3000*2 raw masks + ceil(3000*(ceil(log2(q))+1)/8) chosen-id/valid bits

cache_fit_recompute.finding: The published PWP-only fit matrix is arithmetically correct. Adding current-phase weight and q pattern codes does not change its four capacity thresholds, but materially reduces headroom. Adding the minimum raw-mask and chosen-ID retention required by the modeled full-match-before-compute schedule flips the q16 64-KiB double-context result to false. These buffers may be physically separate, but they must then be explicitly instantiated and area/traffic charged.

area_and_upper_bound_audit.finding: The 2.003053x point assumes q128-wide II=1 matching and a 144-byte PWP path. The 1.429893x shared point removes the wide-PWP gift but still assumes 128 matcher PEs at unchanged frequency. Neither point is area matched to the bit-sparse baseline. The more defensible first executable target is SERIAL16 plus SHARED96 at the analytical 1.405467x q128 starting point.
area_and_upper_bound_audit.why_not_strict: Omitted queue, spill, descriptor and bank costs are candidate-sensitive, while omitted baseline scaling and area tradeoffs can affect the denominator differently. Without a dominance proof the reported ratio is an optimistic recurrence point, not a formal bound on achievable speedup.

p1.title: K-first operand retention and finite queues are absent
p1.impact: The phase is fully matched before its selective DMA and later compute, but raw/correction/chosen-pattern descriptors have no finite storage, port or spill schedule. Current cycle rows are not executable.

p1.title: Capacity and traffic omit pattern-code storage plus executable descriptor context
p1.impact: PWP-only fit remains useful as a sub-cache result, but it cannot be promoted to total double-context fit. Pattern table load/residency is also unpriced.

p1.title: Matcher and port area are not normalized
p1.impact: q128 systolic uses eight times the matcher PEs of SERIAL16, and WIDE144 adds 1.5x payload width. Frequency, area and baseline use of the same budget are unknown.

p1.title: Cycle-upper wording is stronger than the proof
p1.impact: 2.003053x and 1.429893x are reproducible analytical recurrence values, but neither is a strict bound, executable cycle measurement or headline speedup.

p2.title: Per-phase binding/component details are discarded
p2.impact: replay_kfirst computes binding phases and component sums, but the DSE retains only total cycles, making independent diagnosis of overlap sensitivity harder.

p2.title: Complete M248 sample/operator key assertion is implicit
p2.impact: The frozen manifest is complete today; add an explicit exact 10x4 truth-table check to fail closed on future manifests.

p2.title: Nearest-center tie policy is code-defined but not contract-defined
p2.impact: Strict-less comparison deterministically keeps the lowest catalog index. Put this in the interface contract for RTL/reference agreement.

recommended_first_point.reason: It avoids gifting q128 128 matcher PEs or a candidate-only 144-byte port.

required_state: two explicit context IDs with finite occupancy and legal ownership
per-context raw16 or exact correction-descriptor SRAM
per-context chosen pattern ID and valid storage
per-context used-pattern bitmap up to 128 bits
weight, pattern-code and PWP residency valid bits
finite matcher-to-packer, DMA-to-cache and compute-to-commit queues
mandatory_causal_assertions: PWP DMA for context c cannot accept before match_done[c]
preprocess_done[c] implies all used PWP IDs are resident and all descriptors are committed
a context cannot be overwritten until its final commit accepts
every accepted raw row produces exactly one fallback or PWP descriptor
all correction work plus one PWP op equals selected candidate work
both candidate and bit-sparse baseline use the same memory, queue, commit and PE-area budget
common commit is exactly 3000x8 cycles per operator when commit width is one block per cycle
capacity overflow stalls or spills; it never silently assumes fit
minimum_next_executable_module.promotion_gate: Only simulator/RTL cycles from this interface, with zero conservation mismatch and explicit area/Fmax accounting, may replace the M339 unadmitted recurrence values.
